hero.title: Understand the people who use your product.
hero.subtitle: Panda Metrics turns your customers' answers into simple, visual, actionable metrics. Ask, listen and grow.

features.title: Clear feedback, reliable decisions.
features.humanText: Create friendly feedback experiences with faces, stars or your own options.
features.metricsTitle: Metrics that are easy to read
features.metricsText: Turn every answer into visual signals and make better decisions without losing time.
features.allText: Organize your surveys, share them by link, QR or kiosk, and find out what your audience really thinks.

how.title: From question to insight in three steps.
how.step1Text: Pick satisfaction, rating or poll and write your questions.
how.step2Text: Send the link, print the QR or leave a tablet in kiosk mode.
how.step3Text: See answers by day, question and option, in your timezone.

cta.title: Ask questions. Find patterns. Grow with confidence.

footer.tagline: Simple feedback for teams that listen.
